Connect with Authorization: Bearer access token. The chat_id must belong to the authenticated user.

Lifecycle:
1. Send JSON {"message":"..."}.
2. Receive {"type":"start","chat_id":"..."}.
3. Receive one or more {"type":"chunk","content":"..."} messages.
4. Receive {"type":"done","chat_id":"..."}.

Invalid or empty messages produce {"type":"error","detail":"..."}. The server closes unauthorized connections with code 4401 and missing chats with code 4404.

Postman does not pre-send collection item bodies for WebSocket frames; use the example body as the first outgoing frame.

Connect with Authorization: Bearer access token. The optional chat_id query parameter resumes a support session.

Lifecycle:
1. Server sends {"type":"session.started","protocol":"support.chat.v1","chat_id":"..."}.
2. Send {"type":"input.text","text":"..."}.
3. Server sends response.started, zero or more llm.chunk, and response.done.
4. Send {"type":"ping"} for {"type":"pong"}; send {"type":"session.stop"} to receive session.stopped and close code 1000.

Errors use {"type":"error","detail":"..."}. Unauthorized connections close with code 4401.

Connect with Authorization: Bearer access token. This is the support voice protocol.

Supported outgoing events: session.start with optional session_id, input.text with text, input.audio with audio_b64 and mime_type, ping, and session.stop.

Text input produces response.started, llm.chunk, optional tts.chunk, and response.done. Audio input first produces stt.final, then the same response sequence. Errors use {"type":"error","detail":"..."}.

Connect with Authorization: Bearer access token. The server immediately sends session.started with protocol mcp.voice.v1, session_id, and default_agent.

Supported outgoing events: session.start with optional session_id and agent_id, agent.set with agent_id, input.text with text, input.audio with audio_b64 and mime_type, ping, and session.stop.

Text and audio processing responses are service-defined MCP events. The server sends error messages for invalid payloads and closes unauthorized connections with code 4401.
